text: この　ポケモンを　こんな　ばめんで　だしてくるとは！

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a phrase shows surprise at it. だしてくるとは = 'to think you'd bring it out!'.

patterns.name: 〜で (where)
patterns.explanation: で after a place or situation says where something happens. こんな　ばめんで = 'in a situation like this'.
